mainEntity.name: What is the difference between BWP and BWR plywood?

acceptedAnswer.text: BWR meets IS 303 and resists moisture under normal conditions while BWP meets IS 710 and withstands boiling water. Silver and Gold grades are BWR, and Platinum is BWP.

mainEntity.name: Which plywood is best for kitchen cabinets?

acceptedAnswer.text: We recommend Gold grade as the minimum for kitchens, and Platinum grade for areas directly exposed to water or steam like under-sink units.
